THE THREE OVERLAYS NOW BEHAVE ALIKE FOR THE KEYBOARD, AND TWO OF THEM DID NOT. The Drawer has always restored the focus to its opener on close, kept the focus inside itself and cycled Tab within itself. The confirm dialog focused its confirm button and then let the focus fall to the document body when it closed, so the next Tab started from the top of the page with nothing on screen saying that had happened. The popover claimed role="menu" with role="menuitem" children and implemented no arrow-key navigation at all, so a screen reader announced a menu and the arrow keys moved the page. A role is a promise about the behaviour and the arrow keys are the behaviour, so they are there now. Two new interaction cases cover it, and each was driven to failing before it was left passing. The gates live in scripts/ui_interaction_test.py, which is not a node of its own; this node records the behaviour rather than the harness.

THE DESKTOP SHELL NOW EXISTS, AND IT IS THE SAME PRODUCT AS THIS WINDOW. Four things a desktop application is expected to do that a web page cannot: be the only copy of itself, be summoned from another application, answer a zroutery:// URL, and say out loud when it failed with nobody looking at the window. A second launch used to carry on into the setup and fight the first one for the gateway port, because nothing saw it before the rest of the application started; the single-instance plugin is registered before every other plugin for that reason. The window is hidden by default, so the only way back to it was the menu bar, and a menu bar is not a shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+Z now summons it from any application, and a chord the operating system refuses is a warning rather than a reason to refuse to start. A zroutery:// link opens the page it names. And the gateway failing to start from the tray's start item — or at a silent login launch, where on macOS there is no window at all — is reported by a notification, because the tray menu has nowhere to write an error down; a failure that is already a banner in the dashboard is not repeated, since the same message twice is worse than one. The plugins are unconditional dependencies: the feature table is the product's own switchboard, and a desktop shell that changed shape with the ML stack would make the packaged binary depend on a learning flag. See E-148.

THE INTERFACE NOW SAYS ITS STATES IN WORDS, AND ITS CHINESE IN ITS OWN PUNCTUATION. A dot is a colour and a colour is invisible to a screen reader, and the dot is aria-hidden on purpose; every place the design used one to carry a fact had no way to say the fact. The activity timeline was the worst of them — the dot was the row's only sign of whether the request had worked. The word is a caller-supplied string rather than one chosen from the tone, because the tones have no single meaning: "ok" is a request that succeeded on the timeline and a model that is simply enabled on the models page. A field's hint is now a description rather than part of the control's name, and the DOM is deliberately unchanged: the tidier markup moved the hint out of the label, which changed the flex row the field is laid out in, and the layout harness refused it. The harness was right — a change that fixes an accessible name by moving a paragraph is a change that moves a paragraph. Ten toasts put the backend's English straight into a Chinese interface, and the Chinese table itself used ASCII commas and colons in 161 places, which read as though a translation machine had been through it. The English table is untouched, and the comments are left alone: they are read by developers, and the file's English comments use the ASCII marks. See E-149.

AN AUDIT FOUND MORE, AND WHAT IS STILL OPEN IS NAMED HERE RATHER THAN LEFT IMPLIED. A read-only pass over the whole interface found the items this work closed — the colour-only states, the toast that announced itself as "Dismiss", the field hint that was part of the control's name, the overlay that fought the overlay above it, the menu that promised arrow keys and did not deliver them, the select that never said what it held, the select that never gave its placeholder back, and the catalogue row that could not show its own "no tier" option — and a list of things it did not. They are: a select inside a drawer portals its menu outside the drawer's own root, which the drawer's focus trap does not enumerate — that one needs a person to tab through a drawer, and it is not settled; six plain buttons with no type, which is latent rather than broken because there is no form; the provider and model list rows name themselves with an aria-label, which replaces the row's content in the accessibility tree, so the endpoint, the price and the latency are not announced — the state was added to the name for exactly this reason, and the rest of the content is still not in it; the per-row controls in the model tables all share one name, so every tier combobox in a catalogue is announced as "Tier"; the account probe report, the cutover run report and the two learned-routing results are not in a live region, and a failed cutover produces no toast at all, so the report the user most needs is a purely visual change; the browser check-in outcome is never announced, because only the direct and HTTP paths toast; the tabs' aria-controls point at panels that are not rendered; the gateway popover puts rows and separators inside role="menu" without the roles that makes them legal; the drawer's close button is hardcoded English; there is no heading and no landmark anywhere, so a section whose title is a span is not exposed as a region and a screen-reader user cannot navigate by heading; a component is exported and never used and its two tones have no rule; twelve aria-labels and two placeholders are English literals, including four that break the "label in name" rule even in English; sixteen dictionary keys are dead and the error group's copy duplicates the one in the error boundary; full-width brackets are hardcoded for the English interface; two helpers in the api module would render English and are not used; the takeover page matches the backend's reasons with English regular expressions, so a localised backend would stop matching; the type scale is fixed in pixels; a truncation class is defined and never used, and a long model id pushes its row wide; and the strong border colour is 1.48:1 on white where a meaningful boundary wants 3:1. None of these is a blocker, and each is a decision rather than a slip — which is why they are written down instead of quietly left.
